events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde was born on September 7, 1951, in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Still rocking harder than most, Chrissie Hynde, the iconic voice of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today. From Oasis anthems to solo success, he's still a true rock and roll star.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 55 Years On
angles.copy: It's 55 years since John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly now.

events.title: First Apple iPod released
events.blurb: The first-generation Apple iPod was announced on October 23, 2001, and released on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Turns 25
angles.copy: 25 years since Apple dropped the original iPod. Remember carrying your entire music library in your pocket for the first time? Revolutionary.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! It's 007's annual celebration, marking the premiere of Dr. No in 1962. What's your favourite Bond film or gadget?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His legacy continues to inspire generations with his music and message of peace.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, Somerset.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: The legendary John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58 Years
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. Double vinyl, double genius.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Today marks 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61 Years
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' hit shelves 61 years ago today, marking a pivotal moment in their evolving sound. Pure genius.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary, John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally.
